name: codebase-map
description: Feature-level codebase blueprints with a live map inside Claude Code: on-demand mapper instructions with machine-checked edges, an interactive feature map with live highlighting, a freshness band, a CLAUDE.md pointer and an optional Confluence mirror.

claudeMd.title: CLAUDE.md pointer
claudeMd.description: auto: keeps a pointer block to docs/blueprints in CLAUDE.md of repos with a blueprint; off: never writes CLAUDE.md and removes the block at the next session start.

language.title: Language
language.description: de: map, band, CLAUDE.md block and blueprint in German; en: everything in English.
